instructions.title: Review Mission Objectives and Outpost Status
instructions.message: Start at the Mission Control operations station.
instructions.guidance: Review the current objective, mission context, and available Sol 2 readiness report. Note constraints relevant to planning.
instructions.activity: Use the existing Mission Control main interface and submit the context review.

instructions.title: Explore Mars Observation Sites
instructions.message: Proceed to the Mission Control navigation station.
instructions.guidance: Review Target 01, Target 02, and Target 03. Open each target's grayscale, color, and thermal scientific imagery, then read its location, terrain notes, historical observation record, and PHOBOSIA accessibility assessment. Compare all three candidates and note where evidence is unavailable.
instructions.activity: Use the existing observation-site view and submit the site comparison.

instructions.title: Review Communications and Operational Constraints
instructions.message: Review communications and system information in Mission Control.
instructions.guidance: Check available operational constraints and relevant records, then explain how they affect observation planning.
instructions.activity: Use the existing systems interface and submit the constraints review.

instructions.title: Define the Scientific Observation Target
instructions.message: Return to the observation-site information and define a target.
instructions.guidance: After reviewing all three targets and their imagery, choose one target. Read its historical observations and accessibility assessment, write a focused scientific question, reference supporting records, and state the known uncertainties. The site names are PHOBOSIA designations; target-specific NASA records are unavailable where no coordinates are supplied.
instructions.activity: Submit the target definition through the existing navigation interface.

instructions.title: Investigate and Select a Scientific Dataset
instructions.message: Proceed to the Research Analysis Station.
instructions.guidance: Inspect the available dataset metadata and provenance. Evaluate its relevance to your question and record limitations. Available training metadata is not a measurement dataset.
instructions.activity: Select and assess the available catalogue record in the existing analysis interface.

instructions.title: Submit the Scientific Observation Proposal
instructions.message: Return to Mission Control to review and submit the proposal.
instructions.guidance: Review the target, scientific question, dataset, evidence references, operational constraints, and limitations before submitting.
instructions.activity: Submit the validated proposal through the existing Mission Control interface.

completion.title: Sol 3 Required Activities Complete
completion.message: All mandatory Sol 3 activities are complete. Return to the Habitat Rest Area and use the existing rest interaction to conclude the Sol.
